# Run page: planning, needs-info and awaiting-approval states ## What to build The engine's run page (`packages/graph-execution/src/web/page.html` + `src/web/assets/runpage.js`, served by `src/web/server.ts`) shows the plan stage of a `--content` run. Today such a run's page comes up before the planner starts with an empty graph (the web UI is started early by `runPlanned` through `planningUi`, and `WebUiHandle.attach` / `WebServer.setGraph` swap in the real store and layers once the tasks exist), and the process exits at `needs-info` and `awaiting-approval` after closing the page. This slice adds a `plan` view to the page's state and renders it: - **planning**: a panel in place of the empty graph: "Planning…", the attempt `n/N`, the refs, the last rejected-attempt error, and a `plan` step before `tasks` in the phase stepper. - **needs-info**: the questions grouped per ref (refs with a `url` are links), the dropped refs, and the note that the run is final. - **awaiting-approval**: the plan's name, a link to the spec and a link to the task list (both rendered inline on the page from the state, because the run process exits right after), the dropped refs with their questions, and the exact approve / ask-for-changes commands. - **planning failed**: `plan.error`. - The graph appears as soon as the tasks exist (`setGraph`), and dropped refs/questions stay visible in a small panel while the tasks run. When the run process exits at a plan stop, the open tab keeps the last state (no "Disconnected" banner, no reconnect loop) and says that the process has ended. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `docs/prd/automation-api.md` ("Requirements > Engine > Run page"). - `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/run.ts` — `runPlanned` and the shared plan part (`planAndContinue`): where the plan state changes (`planning` with `plan.attempts`, a rejected round with its error, `needs-info`, the end of planning with `plan.name`, `specPath`, `tasksDir`, `plan.dropped`, `plan.questions`, `awaiting-approval`, failure with `plan.error`); the early `planningUi` call with `store: new RunStore(events, { taskIds: [], attempts })`; the later `execute(..., { events })` that creates the real `RunStore` on the same `events`. - `packages/graph-execution/src/state/state.ts` — `planStateSchema` (`contentPath, refs: [{ref, url?, title?}], gate, name?, attempts, questions: [{ref?, questions}], dropped, feedback, error?`), statuses `planning`, `needs-info`, `awaiting-approval`. - `packages/graph-execution/src/plan/paths.ts` — `planSpecRel`, `planTasksRel`, `runInputs` (worktree copies of the planned spec and tasks). - `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/events.ts` (lines 1–30 `PhaseChange`/`RunPhase`, 102–150 `RunEventMap`) — add a `plan:update` event. - `packages/graph-execution/src/ui/store.ts` (lines 87–128 `ViewState`/`RunStoreOptions`, 148–220 the `RunStore` constructor and event folding) — the page state comes from `store.getState()` (spread into the snapshot, `src/web/server.ts` lines 156–175). - `packages/graph-execution/src/web/server.ts` (lines 131–215: `snapshot()`, `/events`, `setGraph`, `close`), `src/web/start.ts` (`startWebUi`, `WebUiHandle.attach/close`), `src/web/serve.ts`, and `src/cli.ts` `serveWeb` (closes the page on `EXIT_NEEDS_INFO`/`EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL`). - `packages/graph-execution/src/web/page.html` (whole, 38 lines), `src/web/assets/runpage.js` (whole, 483 lines: `render`, `renderHeader` with the phase stepper, `renderGraph`, `renderSummary`, `onAction`, `main` with the `EventSource` and `onerror`), `src/web/assets/shell.js` (`visiblePhases`, `renderPhaseStepper`, `showSummaryCard`), `src/web/assets/markdown.js` (`renderMarkdown` at line 110 — render the spec with it), `src/web/assets/util.js` (`div`, `span`), `src/web/assets/runpage.css`. - `apps/graph-manager` caches the page's `/state` (`src/server/viewcache.ts`) — the new `plan` key is just more JSON there. - Tests to mirror: `src/web/server.test.ts` (lines 1–70 `setup`, `openStream`), `src/ui/store.test.ts` (event folding), `src/web/assets/shell.test.ts` (pure helpers of the page, no DOM), `src/web-e2e.test.ts` (detached `--web` run polled through `/state`). - `TESTING.md` "Web view (agent-browser)": UI changes must be checked in a real browser with agent-browser. ## Patterns to follow **Event-sourced view state (`src/ui/store.ts`):** ```typescript events.on("phase:change", (phase) => { ... this.patch({ phase }); }); // new: events.on("plan:update", (plan) => this.patch({ plan })); ``` **Snapshot (`src/web/server.ts:156`):** `JSON.stringify({ ...state, graph: {...}, runId: meta.runId, ... })` — anything in `ViewState` reaches the page and graph-manager's view cache without more code. **Page helpers are pure and tested without a DOM (`src/web/assets/shell.js` + `shell.test.ts`):** ```javascript export function visiblePhases(phases, humanReview) { ... } // tested in shell.test.ts ``` **DOM building (`runpage.js`):** `document.createElement`, `textContent` (never `innerHTML` with run data, except the sanitized `renderMarkdown` output), CSS variables from `theme.css`. ## Step-by-step tasks ### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/events.ts` and `src/ui/store.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `export interface PlanView { status: "planning" | "needs-info" | "awaiting-approval" | "running" | "failed" | "aborted"; attempt: number; attempts: number; refs: { ref: string; url?: string; title?: string }[]; lastError?: string; error?: string; questions: { ref?: string; questions: string[] }[]; dropped: string[]; name?: string; specRel?: string; tasksRel?: string; branch: string; spec?: string; tasks?: { id: string; title: string; dependencies: string[] }[]; approve?: string; replan?: string }` and event `"plan:update": PlanView` in `RunEventMap`. - `ViewState.plan?: PlanView`; `RunStoreOptions.plan?: PlanView` (initial value, so the store `execute` creates keeps the plan); the constructor folds `plan:update` with `this.patch({ plan })`. - **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/ui/store.test.ts` (from `packages/graph-execution`) ### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/run.ts` (plan part) and `src/plan/view.ts` (new) - **IMPLEMENT**: - `src/plan/view.ts`: `planView(state: RunState, runDir: string, extra: { attempts: number; lastError?: string }): Promise` builds the view from `state.plan` and the status; when `plan.name` is set it reads the spec text (from `runInputs(state, runDir).specPath`, capped at 200 000 characters) and the task list (`loadTasks` on the worktree folder: id, first `# ` heading of `content` or the id, dependencies). `approve`/`replan` are the resume commands `graph-execution --resume --run --approve-plan` / `--replan ` (in a sandbox, `SANDBOX_ENV === "1"`, add ` --sandbox` and the hint "or approve it in graph-manager"). - In the plan part of `run.ts`, emit `events.emit("plan:update", await planView(...))` at each change: planning starts (attempt 1/N), a round is rejected (`lastError`), needs-info, planning failed (`error`), planning ended (gate on: `awaiting-approval`; gate off: `running`). Pass the last view as `plan` into the `RunStore` options `execute` creates (add `plan?: PlanView` to `RunGraphOptions` and use it in `execute`'s `new RunStore(...)`, run.ts ~line 309). - **GOTCHA**: Emit before `serveWeb` closes the page: the last `plan:update` must be the stop state. `close()` must send it to the open streams first (next step). - **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/plan` ### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/web/server.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: before `closeServer()` ends the streams, write one final `event: state` with the current snapshot to every open `/events` client (skip the 100 ms throttle), then `event: end` with `{ reason: "exited" }`. Use it in `close()` (the call `serveWeb` makes at a plan stop), not in `POST /close`. - **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/server.test.ts` ### CREATE `packages/graph-execution/src/web/assets/plan.js` (+ `plan.css`, linked in `page.html`) - **IMPLEMENT**: pure helpers, exported and unit-tested: - `planPhases(phases, plan)` → `["plan", ...phases]` when `plan` is set, else `phases`; `planPhaseIndex(plan)` → 0 while `planning`/`needs-info`/`awaiting-approval`. - `planPanel(plan)` → a plain description `{ title, tone: "running" | "warn" | "bad" | "ok", lines: string[], questions: { ref?, url?, title?, questions }[], links: { label, href }[], commands: string[] }`: - `planning`: title `Planning (attempt 2/3)`, `lines` = the refs and `Previous attempt rejected: ` when set. - `needs-info`: title `Needs info`, the questions per ref (url/title joined from `plan.refs`), line `This run is final: answer the questions and start a new run.` - `awaiting-approval`: title `Waiting for approval: `, links `Spec (docs/prd/.md)` → `#plan-spec` and `Tasks ()` → `#plan-tasks`, dropped refs with their questions, `commands` = `[approve, replan]`. - `failed` with `error`: title `Planning failed`, the error. - `running` with dropped refs: title `Dropped: A, B` with their questions; nothing otherwise (return `undefined`). - DOM renderers used by `runpage.js`: `renderPlanPanel(el, panel)`, `renderPlanDocs(el, plan)` (sections `#plan-spec` with `renderMarkdown(plan.spec)` and `#plan-tasks` with an ordered list `id — title (after 1, 2)`), hidden when absent. - **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/assets/plan.test.ts` ### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/web/page.html` and `src/web/assets/runpage.js` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `page.html`: a `
` above `#graph` and a `
` below `#phases`; link `assets/plan.css`. - `render(s)`: `renderPlanPanel`/`renderPlanDocs` from `s.plan`; `renderHeader` uses `planPhases`/`planPhaseIndex` for the stepper (label `planning` / `needs info` / `waiting for approval` for step 0); `renderGraph` hides `#graph` while the graph has no task nodes and `s.plan` is set. - `renderAction`: while `s.plan.status` is `planning` the button is Abort (it stops the planner, same `POST abort`); at `needs-info`/`awaiting-approval` hide it. - `main()`: on `event: end`, close the `EventSource`, set a flag so `onerror` and the 60 s give-up do nothing, and show `The run process has ended. ` in `#conn` (no "Disconnected"). - **GOTCHA**: Run data goes through `textContent`; only `renderMarkdown` output is inserted as HTML (it escapes). Link `href`s from refs: allow only `http:`/`https:` URLs (`new URL(u).protocol`), else render the ref as plain text; add `rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"`. `src/web/assets` is copied into `dist/` by the `postbuild` script (package.json line 51), so a new `plan.js`/`plan.css` needs no build change; check it is served (`src/web/assets.ts`). - **VALIDATE**: `npm run build -w graph-execution` then the browser check below. ### CREATE / UPDATE tests - `src/web/assets/plan.test.ts`: `planPhases`, `planPhaseIndex`, and `planPanel` for each status (planning with a rejected attempt, needs-info with and without refs, awaiting-approval with dropped refs and both commands, failed, running with/without dropped refs), and that a `javascript:` ref url is not turned into a link. - `src/ui/store.test.ts`: `plan:update` lands in `getState().plan`; the `plan` option seeds a new store. - `src/web/server.test.ts`: `/state` includes `plan` after a `plan:update`; `close()` sends a final `state` then `end` to an open stream. - `src/web-e2e.test.ts` (regression): `--content c.md --provider fake --web` (gate on, detached): poll `/state` while it is up or read the last SSE message, and assert the final state has `plan.status === "awaiting-approval"`, `plan.name === "fake-plan"`, `plan.spec` contains `# Fake plan`, `plan.tasks[0].id === "1"`, then the process exits. - Browser check (TESTING.md "Web view (agent-browser)"): run `node $CLI --content "$REPO/.git/c.md" --provider fake --web` with `GRAPH_EXECUTION_HANDOFF=detached SSH_CONNECTION=1` and a fake script `{"planner:plan":{"attempts":[{"hang":true}]}}` to hold it in `planning` (screenshot the planning panel), then without it (screenshot awaiting-approval with the spec and task list), with `NOT-READY` (screenshot needs-info), and with `--no-plan-gate` (the graph appears, run ends applied). Check both light and dark themes. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] While planning, the run page shows "Planning (attempt n/N)", the refs, and a `plan` step in the stepper; no empty graph canvas. - [ ] At `needs-info` the page shows the questions per ref (ref links only for http/https URLs) and that the run is final. - [ ] At `awaiting-approval` the page shows the plan name, links to the spec and the task list (rendered on the page), the dropped refs with questions, and the approve / replan commands; after the process exits the tab keeps this view and says the process has ended. - [ ] With `--no-plan-gate` the graph appears once the tasks exist and the run continues on the same page. - [ ] `/state` carries `plan` (graph-manager's view cache stores it). - [ ] Tests pass: `npm run build -w graph-execution && npm test -w graph-execution` ## Validation commands ```bash # Type / lint npm run typecheck && npm run lint # Tests for this slice npm run build -w graph-execution cd packages/graph-execution && npx vitest run src/web src/ui/store.test.ts src/plan src/web-e2e.test.ts && cd ../.. # Whole suite npm test ```
